app.name: Sacred Pair
app.tagline: Bringing people together, one individual at a time.

landing.title: Find a life partner, then grow together.
landing.body: Sacred Pair is for people who are serious about a lasting relationship. Each week you see four thoughtfully chosen profiles. When you both choose each other, you start a journey together.

discover.title: Discover
discover.emptyTitle: Your four profiles for this week
discover.emptyBody: Tap the magic wand to see four people chosen for you. New profiles arrive every week.

details.title: Details
details.emptyBody: Choose a profile in Discover to see their full story here.

together.title: Together
together.emptyTitle: Your journey starts with a connection
together.emptyBody: When you and someone else choose each other, you can pick a path together: grow a tree, build a house, or write a book.

chat.title: Chat
chat.emptyBody: Conversations open when two people choose each other. Nobody can message you before that.

profile.title: Profile
profile.emptyBody: Add your name, a photo and a few lines about yourself so others can get to know you.

aside.title: Four introductions a week. No endless swiping.
aside.body: When two people choose each other, they start a journey together: growing a tree, building a house, or writing a book.

fields.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with uppercase and lowercase letters and a number.
fields.phoneHint: For account security only. It never appears on your profile.
fields.birthdateHint: You must be 18 or older. Only your age appears on your profile.

errors.heading: Check the highlighted fields.
errors.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
errors.samePassword: Choose a password you haven't used here before.
errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a mobile number with its area code, like (555) 123-4567.
errors.underage: You must be 18 or older to join Sacred Pair.
errors.termsRequired: Agree to the Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy to continue.
errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match an account.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email before logging in. The link is in the email we sent when you signed up.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.linkInvalid: This link has expired or has already been used.
errors.sessionMissing: Your reset link has expired. Request a new one to set your password.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

notices.linkResent: We sent a new link. It can take a minute to arrive.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.intro: Sacred Pair is for adults looking for a lasting relationship. Each week we introduce you to four people.
signup.terms: I agree to the <terms>Terms and Conditions</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
signup.marketing: Email me dating tips and news. You can stop anytime.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm your account. The link works for one hour.
checkEmail.bodyNoEmail: We sent you a link. Open it to confirm your account. The link works for one hour.
checkEmail.notArrived: Nothing yet? Check your spam folder, or send the link again.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter the email you signed up with. We'll send a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account uses {email}, we've sent it a link to reset the password. The link works for one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.needsLink: To set a new password, open the reset link from your email on this device.

confirm.emailBody: One last step to finish creating your account.
confirm.recoveryBody: Continue to choose a new password.
confirm.incomplete: This link is incomplete. Open it straight from the email, or ask for a new one.
confirm.expiredSignup: Log in with your email and password and we'll offer to send a new link.
confirm.expiredRecovery: Ask for a new reset link.
confirm.requestReset: Send me a new reset link

welcome.title: Your email is confirmed
welcome.body: Welcome to Sacred Pair. Your account is ready.

legal.placeholder: This page will hold the full policy once it has been reviewed. It is published before Sacred Pair opens to the public.
